title: The Letter at Inverness
summary: A letter brings the witches’ promise to Inverness. Lady Macbeth chooses what power should mean.
opening_narration: I read my husband’s letter twice. Its promise sounds like a door opening; I must decide whether to urge him through it.

available_choices.description: Counsel patience and a lawful rise.
Urge Macbeth to help fate with deliberate action.

title: A King Under My Roof
summary: Duncan arrives as an honored guest. Lady Macbeth can strengthen Macbeth’s resolve or prevent the household from crossing a line.
opening_narration: Duncan thanks me for my welcome. Behind the courtesy, I see Macbeth weighing the crown against the man who trusts us.

available_choices.description: Tell Macbeth Duncan’s trust makes murder indefensible.
Take command of the plan and prepare the guards’ drink.

title: The Night of the Deed
summary: Macbeth returns from Duncan’s chamber. Lady Macbeth may conceal the murder, expose it, or stop it before it happens.
opening_narration: A cry breaks the night. Macbeth stands before me with the daggers. I can still choose what happens next.

available_choices.description: Conceal the deed and direct suspicion at the guards.
Call witnesses and reveal the deed before the household settles.
Wake the household and prevent Duncan’s murder.

title: The Crown and the Distance
summary: As queen, Lady Macbeth finds influence cannot command affection. She may confront Macbeth, protect him, or seek separation.
opening_narration: The crown is mine to wear, yet every corridor feels farther from Macbeth. The court watches us for weakness.

available_choices.description: Challenge Macbeth’s violence and demand he stop ruling by fear.
Conceal his instability and preserve your influence.
Seek safety and a negotiated separation.

title: The Banquet and the Plot
summary: Macbeth’s fear turns toward Banquo. Lady Macbeth can enable the murder, warn Banquo and Fleance, or compel Macbeth to spare his friend.
opening_narration: The banquet is being prepared. Macbeth’s servants await an order concerning Banquo, and I can still shape what happens next.

available_choices.description: Permit the plot against Banquo and keep the court quiet.
Warn Banquo and Fleance before the killers reach them.
Confront Macbeth and insist Banquo be spared.

title: A Living Witness at the Feast
summary: After Lady Macbeth enabled Banquo’s murder, his ghost appears at the banquet. She can shield Macbeth or name what the court sees.
opening_narration: Macbeth stares at a place no living guest occupies. I know why Banquo is absent, and the court is beginning to ask.

available_choices.description: Dismiss the king’s terror and send the witnesses away.
Acknowledge Banquo’s murder and confront Macbeth in public.

title: The Sleepless Queen
summary: Sleep returns Lady Macbeth to the bloodied night. She can confess, seek reconciliation, or leave the court alive.
opening_narration: I wake with my hands raw from washing. The physician waits at the door; Macbeth has not asked what I remember.

available_choices.description: Confess to the physician and let the truth reach Malcolm.
Ask Macbeth for one honest conversation before the rebellion.
Leave Dunsinane under protection.

title: The Crown Refused
summary: Duncan lives; Lady Macbeth prevented a crime that would bind her future to blood.
opening_narration: I chose the king’s life over the crown. The danger remains, but this night does not become our secret.

title: A Truth Spoken
summary: Lady Macbeth accepts responsibility and gives Scotland evidence to judge her.
opening_narration: My confession cannot undo the dead. It can end the lie that my hands were clean.

title: A Narrow Truce
summary: Lady Macbeth and Macbeth reckon honestly and negotiate an end to their rule.
opening_narration: We meet without courtiers between us. At last neither of us has to pretend.

title: Beyond the Castle
summary: Lady Macbeth survives the regime’s fall and begins a life apart from its power.
opening_narration: I leave the castle alive, carrying what I did and the chance to answer for it.

title: The Prophecy Shared
location: Forres and the roads of Scotland
summary: Banquo hears his descendants will be kings and chooses whether to investigate, conceal, or tell Fleance.
opening_narration: The sisters promise Macbeth a crown and my children a line of kings. I decide what to do with a future no one can prove.

available_choices.description: Question the sisters and record every word.
Keep the prophecy private and speak with Fleance.
Tell Fleance enough to prepare without promising a throne.

title: The King’s New Favorite
location: Forres and the roads of Scotland
summary: Macbeth rises after the prophecy. Banquo can warn Duncan, remain a wary friend, or seek political support.
opening_narration: Macbeth is named Thane of Cawdor. The first promise has come true, and silence feels like a decision.

available_choices.description: Warn Duncan that Macbeth may be ruled by prophecy.
Offer friendship while watching Macbeth’s choices.
Build quiet support among the thanes.

title: A King’s Uneasy Friend
location: Forres and the roads of Scotland
summary: Banquo suspects Macbeth seized the crown by foul means. He may challenge him, leave Scotland, or protect Fleance at court.
opening_narration: The crown is on Macbeth’s head, but peace has not followed. I choose whether to confront him or protect my son first.

available_choices.description: Challenge Macbeth’s account before the nobles.
Arrange a discreet route out of Scotland for Fleance.
Remain at court and keep suspicion private.

title: The Road at Dusk
summary: Hired killers close around Banquo and Fleance. Banquo’s decision determines the fate of both father and son.
opening_narration: Hooves approach from behind. I see steel in the dusk and put myself between danger and my son.

available_choices.description: Use the prepared route and escape together.
Hold the attackers while Fleance escapes alone.
Fight to survive and keep Fleance beside you.

title: The King’s Banquet
summary: Banquo returns alive to Macbeth’s banquet. The murdered man’s ghost cannot appear while Banquo lives; the king must face his living witness.
opening_narration: I take the place prepared for me. Macbeth turns pale when he sees me, and I decide whether the hall hears the truth.

available_choices.description: Name Macbeth’s crimes before the assembled thanes.
Leave the hall with Fleance and carry your testimony to Malcolm.

title: The Witness Lives
summary: Banquo and Fleance escape the murder plot; Scotland has a living witness.
opening_narration: I live, and Fleance lives. Macbeth’s crimes are no longer unwitnessed.

title: A Son Carries the Future
summary: Banquo dies buying Fleance a chance to choose his own future.
opening_narration: My last sight is Fleance running free. No prophecy can command what he becomes.

title: A Thane at Home
summary: Macduff begins in Fife with his family and must decide whether loyalty to the new king still means loyalty to Scotland.
opening_narration: The old king is dead and rumors travel fast. My wife asks what safety means when the crown itself is suspect.

available_choices.description: Return to court and investigate before condemning Macbeth.
Keep the family together while gathering testimony.
Refuse to praise Macbeth until Duncan’s death is investigated.

title: The New King’s Court
summary: Macduff sees a frightened court. He can gather evidence, warn his household, or contact Malcolm.
opening_narration: The thanes watch one another before speaking. I must act before Macbeth can strike.

available_choices.description: Compare accounts of Duncan’s death with trusted thanes.
Warn Lady Macduff and arrange a safe house.
Open a secret channel to Malcolm in England.

title: The Household’s Choice
summary: Macbeth’s messengers are near. Macduff decides whether his family is moved to safety before he leaves Scotland.
opening_narration: I have a narrow window. My family’s fate is not written; I choose where to place them.

available_choices.description: Move wife and child to a trusted refuge, then seek Malcolm.
Hide the household with loyal neighbors and leave a false trail.
Leave alone and trust the household to fend for itself.

title: An Alliance in Exile
summary: Malcolm tests Macduff’s loyalty. Macduff chooses a just coalition, revenge, or a negotiated transition.
opening_narration: Malcolm asks whether I grieve for Scotland or only for my house. I answer before asking him to trust me.

available_choices.description: Swear to restore Scotland under law and protect its people.
Demand Macbeth’s life for the dead in your household.
Ask Malcolm to offer surrender terms before advancing.

title: Birnam Wood Moves
summary: The army advances under branches from Birnam Wood. Macduff may challenge Macbeth, demand surrender, or secure the city.
opening_narration: The hillside seems to move. At last Macbeth must answer for his rule.

available_choices.description: Seek Macbeth in battle and challenge him directly.
Offer one last chance to surrender and stand trial.
Protect the city from a final royal order.

title: Scotland Freed
summary: Macduff helps defeat Macbeth; the household’s fate follows the choices made in Fife.
opening_narration: Macbeth’s power is broken. If my family lives, I return to them; if not, justice must serve those who remain.

title: A Trial Instead of a Crown
summary: Macbeth is taken alive and faces judgment; Scotland begins recovery under Malcolm.
opening_narration: The king is disarmed and taken to answer before Scotland. No more lives need be spent for my revenge.
